1.name: The Birth of an Artist
1.overview: Audrey has spent her life in her sister’s shadow, a talented painter no one ever noticed. Inside Asphodel, wearing Mira’s face, she finally has the attention she’s always craved. The closer she gets to the truth about Mira, the more the retreat offers her everything she ever wanted. Every answer has a price, and every step toward the truth is also a step toward the life that broke Mira.

overview:
When the most celebrated young artist of her generation, Mira Kore, jumps from a penthouse balcony to her death, her identical twin sister, Audrey, takes Mira’s name, face and invitation to Asphodel, in search of the truth behind why she jumped.

Asphodel is an elite art retreat run by Dion Bach, the living god of art and Mira’s former mentor. A single word from Dion can make or break a career, and every artist invited knows it. That's why they're here. There is only one rule: create something of worth. Here, success is measured in bodies, not brushstrokes, and those who fail to impress Dion don’t simply go home. They become part of someone else’s work...
title: The Death of an Artist
